briefs.title: Jenn Levy named Head of Unscripted and Documentary TV - Friedlander memo (Deadline)
briefs.summary: Single leader for all unscripted; remit covers development and production for Prime Video; Levy tasked with finding Love Is Blind-scale hits.

briefs.title: Jenny Groom named Head of MGM Alternative - Levy memo (Variety)
briefs.summary: MGM Alternative to develop new formats and series for Prime Video and to sell 'all around town'.

commissioners.name: Jenn Levy
commissioners.title: Head of Unscripted and Documentary Television, Amazon MGM Studios
commissioners.remit: Oversees all unscripted and documentary TV: Amazon MGM Unscripted, MGM Alternative, Big Fish Entertainment and Evolution Media report to her; development and production for Prime Video. Reports to Peter Friedlander, head of global TV. (Variety Nov 2026 calls her 'nonfiction head'.)
commissioners.notes: No specific title found credited to her as commissioner.

commissioners.name: Ariane Wu
commissioners.title: Senior Creative Executive, Documentary Series
commissioners.remit: Documentary series; reports to Jenn Levy. Previously eight years at Netflix (director of original documentary film from 2020; The Tinder Swindler)
commissioners.notes: Most relevant Amazon contact for docuseries.

commissioners.name: Tiffany Faigus
commissioners.title: Senior Creative Executive, Unscripted Series
commissioners.remit: Unscripted series; reports to Jenn Levy. Ex-SVP unscripted and alternative at ABC / Walt Disney Television Alternative

commissioners.name: Jenny Groom
commissioners.title: Head of MGM Alternative
commissioners.remit: Survivor, Shark Tank, The Voice and the format library; developing new formats and series for Prime Video and third-party buyers; reports to Jenn Levy
commissioners.notes: MGM Alternative is a studio/production arm that also sells to other networks - formats-focused, less relevant to docs.
